title: TrainerRoad Missed Workout Streak
app: COROS, Wahoo ELEMNT, TrainerRoad, Apple Fitness / HealthKit exports, Concept2 Logbook, Strava, Garmin Connect, and Zwift activity feeds via official APIs, FIT/CSV exports, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainerroad:workout status!=completed
| bin _time span=14d
| stats count as missed_sessions by athlete _time
| where missed_sessions>2
| sort - missed_sessions
description: Uses TrainerRoad calendar exports telemetry to monitor missed-session accumulation over the last two weeks in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for when a build block is slipping before fitness drops, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest TrainerRoad calendar exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a weekly cadence.
visualization: Two-week column chart of missed workouts per athlete.
grandmaExplanation: It records missed-session accumulation over the last two weeks so you can spot when a build block is slipping before fitness drops before it becomes annoying.
